pairs: Aderant autem quidam ipso in tempore,
And there were present, at that very time,
nuntiantes illi de Galilæis, quorum sanguinem Pilatus miscuit cum sacrificiis eorum.
some who were reporting about the Galileans, whose blood Pilate mixed with their sacrifices.
And responding, he said to them:
Putatis quod hi Galilæi præ omnibus Galilæis peccatores fuerint,
“Do you think that these Galileans must have sinned more than all other Galileans,
Sicut illi decem et octo, supra quos cecidit turris in Siloë, et occidit eos:
And those eighteen upon whom the tower of Siloam fell and killed them,
putatis quia et ipsi debitores fuerint præter omnes homines habitantes in Jerusalem?
do you think that they also were greater transgressors than all the men living in Jerusalem?

And he also told this parable:
“A certain man had a fig tree,
Arborem fici habebat quidam plantatam in vinea sua,
which was planted in his vineyard.
et venit quærens fructum in illa,
And he came seeking fruit on it,
Then he said to the cultivator of the vineyard:
Ecce anni tres sunt ex quo venio quærens fructum in ficulnea hac,
‘Behold, for these three years I came seeking fruit on this fig tree,
For why should it even occupy the land?’
Domine dimitte illam et hoc anno,
let it be for this year also,
during which time I will dig around it and add fertilizer.
And, indeed, it should bear fruit.
in the future, you shall cut it down.’”
Erat autem docens in synagoga eorum sabbatis.
Now he was teaching in their synagogue on the Sabbaths.
quæ habebat spiritum infirmitatis annis decem et octo:
there was a woman who had a spirit of infirmity for eighteen years.
and she was unable to look upwards at all.
you are released from your infirmity.”
And he laid his hands upon her,
the ruler of the synagogue became angry that Jesus had cured on the Sabbath,
dicebat turbæ: Sex dies sunt in quibus oportet operari:
and he said to the crowd: “There are six days on which you ought to work.
in his ergo venite, et curamini,
Therefore, come and be cured on those,
and not on the day of the Sabbath.”
Then the Lord said to him in response:
Does not each one of you,
unusquisque vestrum sabbato non solvit bovem suum,
release his ox or donkey from the stall,
should not this daughter of Abraham,
whom Satan has bound for lo these eighteen years,
non oportuit solvi a vinculo isto die sabbati?
be released from this restraint on the day of the Sabbath?”
Et cum hæc diceret, erubescebant omnes adversarii ejus:
And as he was saying these things, all his adversaries were ashamed.
et omnis populus gaudebat in universis, quæ gloriose fiebant ab eo.
And all the people rejoiced in everything that was being done gloriously by him.
“To what is the kingdom of God similar,
and to what figure shall I compare it?
It is like a grain of mustard seed,
quod acceptum homo misit in hortum suum,
which a man took and cast into his garden.
et factum est in arborem magnam:
and it became a great tree,
et volucres cæli requieverunt in ramis ejus.
and the birds of the air rested in its branches.”
“To what figure shall I compare the kingdom of God?
quod acceptum mulier abscondit in farinæ sata tria,
which a woman took and hid in three measures of fine wheat flour,
Et ibat per civitates et castella, docens,
And he was traveling through the cities and towns,
teaching and making his way to Jerusalem.
are they few who are saved?”

when the father of the family will have entered and shut the door,

discedite a me omnes operarii iniquitatis.
Depart from me, all you workers of iniquity!’
Ibi erit fletus et stridor dentium:
In that place, there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth,
et omnes prophetas in regno Dei,
and all the prophets, in the kingdom of God,
yet you yourselves are expelled outside.
And they will arrive from the East,
and they will recline at table in the kingdom of God.
Et ecce sunt novissimi qui erunt primi,
And behold, those who are last will be first,
et sunt primi qui erunt novissimi.
and those who are first will be last.”

On the same day, some of the Pharisees approached,
et vade hinc: quia Herodes vult te occidere.
and go away from here. For Herod wishes to kill you.”
Ecce ejicio dæmonia, et sanitates perficio hodie,
I cast out demons and accomplish healings, today and tomorrow.
et cras, et tertia die consummor.
And on the third day I reach the end.’
Verumtamen oportet me hodie et cras et sequenti die ambulare:
Yet truly, it is necessary for me to walk today and tomorrow and the following day.
quia non capit prophetam perire extra Jerusalem.
For it does not fall to a prophet to perish beyond Jerusalem.

and you stone those who are sent to you. Daily,
quoties volui congregare filios tuos quemadmodum avis nidum suum sub pennis,
I wanted to gather together your children, in the manner of a bird with her nest under her wings,
Ecce relinquetur vobis domus vestra deserta.
Behold, your house will be left desolate for you.
quia non videbitis me donec veniat cum dicetis:
that you shall not see me, until it happens that you say:
Benedictus qui venit in nomine Domini.
‘Blessed is he who has arrived in the name of the Lord.’”
